Hi Priya / Mark,

Thanks again for taking time today — appreciated the context on where Bridgewater is with embedding LLM features into the clinician workflow. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps: 

Summary (short):
- Primary use case: triage summarization & suggested follow-ups inside EHR; 80% of tokens are short clinical notes (avg 120 tokens).
- Success criteria: 90% reduction in clinician study time on administrative tasks; latency target: 200-300ms p50 per token for in-app responses.
- Constraints: PHI handling, on-prem/VPC requirement for production, SOC2/compliance evidence needed.

Suggested next steps:
1) Quick technical deep-dive with our SE (30 min) — we can run through KV cache approach and prefix-caching to meet latency targets.
2) Pilot scope: 90-day pilot, up to 100k tokens/day, staging in VPC, metrics dashboard.
3) Pricing ballpark: we’ll propose an initial pilot credit + success-based pricing — follow-up with exact numbers after SE alignment.

I attached my notes from the call (bridgewater_discovery_notes.pdf). If you’re comfortable, I’ll loop in our SE (Neha) and CS (Monica) to lock down pilot scope and timeline. If there’s a better person on your side to include, let me know.

Would love a quick thumbs-up on next steps or a preferred time for the technical deep-dive.

Thanks,
